candidates.locator: Outline of the Faith (BCP p. 849) — God the Son: Q. What is the nature of God revealed in Jesus?
candidates.rationale: Direct confessional statement that God's very nature is love, meeting the floor fully.
candidates.chunk_text: What is the nature of God revealed in Jesus? God is love.

candidates.locator: Outline of the Faith (BCP p. 846) — God the Father: Q. What does this mean?
candidates.phrase: the work of a single loving God who creates, sustains, and directs it
candidates.rationale: Asserts that God the Father is loving as a defining character trait in creating and sustaining the universe.
candidates.chunk_text: What does this mean? This means that the universe is good, that it is the work of a single loving God who creates, sustains, and directs it.

candidates.locator: Outline of the Faith (BCP p. 846) — God the Father: Q. What does this mean about human life?
candidates.phrase: all can respond to the love of God
candidates.rationale: Affirms that love is God's own attribute directed toward humanity, a narrower but valid instance of divine love.
candidates.chunk_text: What does this mean about human life? It means that all people are worthy of respect and honor, because all are created in the image of God, and all can respond to the love of God.
